content: Claude Code stream-json: NDJSON, first event is system/init carrying session_id, model, tools, mcp servers. Hooks include Stop, Notification, SubagentStop, PostToolUse among 30+ lifecycle events; every hook payload includes session_id and cwd as common fields from the very first hook call (SessionStart), so session_id is never unknown to the hook itself, only to the daemon until it reads stdout or the hook fires.
